meterNotAccessible.reason: Meter is outside with a clear front working area; only movable tools/materials and adjacent equipment/conduit are shown.

panelNotAccessible.reason: Panel is outside and reachable from the front; no fixed obstruction or boxing-in is visible.

panelInHouse.reason: Panel is clearly mounted on an exterior wall.

notSameWall.reason: Meter and panel are plainly outside on the same exterior wall.
